messages:
emma: Postmortem follow-up for ACME dedicated/on-prem outage. Need concrete owners for peering fixes, repro, and validation plan. Short timelines please.
raj: I can take peering ACL + route fix. Blockers: customer routing creds + infra signoff. ETA target: maintenance window next Wed.
nina: Ill own the isolation repro harness and test cases. Goal: minimal repro + CI test by Thu.
tom: Security/compliance review required before any route advertisement change. Ill do a 30-min review tomorrow 09:30 PT. Attach ACL diffs please.
leah: Ill coordinate with ACME for the window and request BGP logs to be streamed. Confirmed they can provide logs during maintenance.
raj: Added tracker ticket: https://r-internal/tracker/INC-ACME-882. Setting ETA 2026-04-16 for final close pending validation.
infra-bot: Temporary routing creds issued to raj (scope: read/routes, write/routes). Expires in 48h.
nina: Repro note: failure reproduces when on-prem NAT churn + asymmetric egress causes BGP keepalive drops. Adding a synthetic NAT churn test to the harness.
tom: Draft ACL snippet attached to tracker:
```
# ACL draft
permit tcp 172.31.0.0/16 any eq 179
deny ip any 172.31.0.0/16
```
Please confirm before PR.
emma: Action recap:
- Raj: implement ACL + routing tweak, owner, ETA: Wed window
- Nina: repro harness + CI tests, owner, ETA: Thu
- Tom: sec/compliance review, owner, meeting tomorrow
- Leah: customer coordination + logs, owner
Mark items blocked if creds/window/sec approval missing.
raj: Ill post PR for routing changes and request infra oncall signoff. Canary plan: announce restricted prefixes, validate with traffic mirroring, rollback if unexpected announcements.
oncall-bot: Reminder: infra oncall must approve route changes >=2h before maintenance.
leah: Confirmed with ACME: window Wed 02:00-04:00 UTC. They will stream BGP logs to secure bucket.
nina: This matches earlier "peering flap" incidents. Recommend creating a peering-flap alert (owner: eng-sre) and a short remediation playbook snippet. Ill draft the runbook.
tom: Security note: verify no route leak by checking AS-path & prefix-set after canary. Add automated verification step to canary.
emma: Scheduling a 15-min owner sync Fri 10:00 PT. Please update tracker statuses (blocked/in-progress/done). Close condition: canary validated + no BGP resets for 24h after change. Thanks :thumbsup:
